R4E-bear-backcountry-0004.name: 120 m NW of Giegerich Creek
R4E-bear-backcountry-0004.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R4E-bear-backcountry-0004.parkWhat: pull off on Duncan River FSR (gravel road)

evidence.t: Burn from 2023 (fire N72419), right here: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
SE facing slope, 31 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Giegerich Creek 120 m SE: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

flags.t: Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: bag 2; private land only, with landowner permission

plan: Drive: from Village of Radium Hot Springs, about 96 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 50.71167, -117.1115, pull off on Duncan River FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 7.4 km NE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 942 m, about 243 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 140 m SE of the spot at 1,073 m (50.74348, -117.01836). Water: Giegerich Creek 20 m N (estimate).

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-27, Region 4. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-01, closures 2026-10-16.
R4E-bear-backcountry-0004.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 4-27: about 96 hunter days a year for black bear (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.06 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
